listing.aiSummary: Displays fleet strength statistics, including ship counts, deployment points, autoresolve power, and estimated experience bonuses, before engaging an enemy fleet.

description:
Download link: https://github.com/Seekers6967/starsector-show_encounter_stats/releases/latest/download/ShowEncounterStats.rar
Repo: https://github.com/Seekers6967/starsector-show_encounter_stats

Requires Lunalib and Lazylib as of v1.1.0.

This is an utility mod, it can be added or removed mid save.

Small mod that adds various info when you encounter a fleet but before deciding to engage it.

Displays information such as number of ships on each side, DP total, autoresolve strenght (Fleet Power or FP) and the estimated +%EXP bonus due to battle difficulty (using vanilla calcs). Excludes civilian ships from the number of ships and DP count, as they are not really relevant but it does count the FP they contribute (and will tell you separately how much civvies are contributing which is usually not a lot, mothballed ships are also not counted and they dont add FP so yeah also skips those).

When its just a 1v1 fight its pretty straightforward, if its you fighting multiple fleets, all the enemy fleets will be combined and counted as one.

Also supports allied fleets!, you can bump into one to see how strong are your patrols actually are.

And even supports ongoing combats!, see those gigantic 15 fleet battles in nex of about 7 different factions clashing in your system? Well you can now check out how the battle is going by clicking on the enemy fleet which will show you the stats on your allied doomstack (yourself being excluded) vs the enemy doomstack; letting you know if you actually have go to in and handle it or if you can just let the mess of fleets sort each other out.

At first it was a discord only mod I discovered in USC back in 0.96 release that did pretty much the same thing except also counted civilian ships, didnt separate civvie FP from warship FP and didnt tell you how the %EXP. Sadly I lost the original post was either deleted or is so buried I couldnt find it, however the original author did publish the mod as a "DO WHATEVER YOU WANT" license so I just kept changing things and kept their name in the authors section (as they did 99% of the work).

KNOWN BUGS: Stations break the +%EXP bonus.
Does not cover all the ways you can encounter a fleet, so for the more complicated encounters it may not show you the numbers.

Changelog:

Spoiler
V1.1.2
BUGFIX: Officer count is now fully functional and no longer bad and stinky (fixed multiple bugs related to how it calculated avg lvl, how it collected officer data and so on, it now finally works correctly).

Cleaned up duplicate code.
Cleaned up some weird logic.

V1.1.1 Hotifx

Fixed bug that made AI cores not count as officers.

V1.1.0

THIS UPDATE CHANGES THE INTERNAL MOD ID, YOU WILL TO SELECT IT AGAIN AS THE GAME WILL THINK ITS A NEW MOD.

Save-compat (as all updates will be since utility mod).

Added lunalib support with 4 toggles:
- Shorten Descriptions: massively decrease the amount of text, not really needed if you just use the current features but once I implement ways to show every ship individually and such, well ur gonna need it. Default is false.
- Show Civilian Ships FP: toggles showing how much fleet strenght is contributed by civ ships, if false the line wont be shown but it will count towards the total fleet strenght. Default is true.
- Count civilian ships: self explanatory, counts civ ships as if they were combat ships, counting them as total ships and their DP. Default is false.
- Show officer count: New feature! toggles wether to show how many officers each fleet has and their average level. Default is true.

Refactored code (read, made a mess of the code myself, then had chatgpt clean it up ending up with more of a mess, im sorry).

Added a bug (yippee): Does not count enemy flagship officer for some reason, will be fixed soon.

TO DO

- Fix bugs
- When you encounter an ongoing battle, inform you if you can autoresolve it if you get involved.
- Display more detailed stats (default will stay as is or minimal changes, because displaying too much will just lead to clutter but may be useful for modders wishing to see some stats, or well people interested in numbers; because really you dont need to know how much FP is the enemy onslaught adding compared to the kite)
